known_gaps: Red cards: the official match page renders 0 dismissal events across all 130 matches while FotMob reports some; the dismissal block is not exposed in the parsed sections, so red cards are left empty instead of being guessed.
Assists: the official J.League match record does not publish an assisting player, so the column stays blank.
Formations: not published on the official match record page, so both formation columns stay blank.
Coaches/venue/referee/attendance are missing for 1 fixture each (page layout variant).
xG is a third party derived value, not an official J.League figure.
